title: The design notes of closed steps distributed: docs/dev/internals/ and a manual chapter on symbolic user functions
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG11.12 (decided: the design notes grew in number and size; what is implemented goes into the docs, merged notes contain only the implemented status and the decisions; docs/dev/internals/; closed notes moved to tmp/delete/; symbolic gets a place of its own in the manual): the eleven notes of docs/dev/design for closed steps merged into docs/dev/internals/symbolic.md, userFunctions.md, userItems.md, systemUtilities.md, symmetricBasis.md, contributions into WORKFLOW.md; a chapter docs/manual/symbolicUserFunctions.md; the measurement scripts to tools/benchmarks; the rule for design notes in WORKFLOW.md.
releaseNotes: The manual has a chapter on symbolic user functions: a first one with its check, how to write a function that records, vectors, matrices and the user items, speed and threads, a recording as code. The developer documentation has docs/dev/internals/ - exudyn.symbolic inside, the user functions at the C++/Python boundary, the user items, systemUtilities and the symmetric basis -, from the design notes of the closed steps, whose measurement scripts are in tools/benchmarks.
